title: Add simple tonemapping, exposure, and gamma to Composite
summary: Extend the fullscreen Composite pass with a clampable exposure control, Reinhard (or ACES) tonemap, and gamma correction for consistent display output.
rationale: Volume brightness varies across densities and step sizes. A basic tonemapper helps compare compute vs DXR outputs and stabilizes perceived brightness.
steps: Add constant buffer or root constants for {exposure, gamma}.
Implement Reinhard tonemap: color/(1+color) with exposure pre-scale.
Apply pow(color, 1.0/gamma) before writing to swapchain.
Add keyboard controls: +/- exposure, [ ] gamma; log values.
Validate with HDR patterns and volume outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Exposure/gamma adjustable at runtime; logged values reflect changes.
Image remains stable without clipping or banding.
PIX shows updated constants bound for Composite draw.
